up: Find all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5728513'. Return the molecule ChEMBL ID and the preferred name for each compound. Do not apply any filters on assay confidence scores, target types, or document types unless explicitly requested. Ensure the join path is from docs to compound_records to molecule_dictionary.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728513'
